name: ky-nay
description: Ky Nay - UET timetable planner: domain/parser/export packages and the M3 web app (apps/web). Docs: docs/README.md

scripts.typecheck: tsc -b tsconfig.build.json --pretty false && npm run typecheck -w @ky-nay/web
scripts.test: npm run build && node scripts/run-node-tests.mjs && npm run test -w @ky-nay/web
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run e2e -w @ky-nay/web
scripts.test:visual: npm run build && npm run e2e -w @ky-nay/web -- --project=visual
scripts.fixtures:run: npm run build && node packages/parser/dist/bin/run-fixtures.js fixtures --verbose
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run fixtures:run && node scripts/dataset.mjs check
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run dev -w @ky-nay/web
scripts.build:web: npm run build && npm run build:site -w @ky-nay/web
scripts.verify:bundle: npm run build:web && node scripts/verify-production-bundle.mjs && node scripts/check-bundle-budget.mjs
